subject: Demo recap + proposed pilot roadmap for Riverstone Analytics evaluation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@riverstoneanalytics.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@riverstoneanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed pilot roadmap for Riverstone Analytics evaluation

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the demo with us today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal for a 6-week evaluation so we can validate latency, cost per inference, and throughput for your batch and interactive use cases. High level:

- Goal: demonstrate parity with existing inference pipeline for extract + classify flows while reducing per-token cost by at least 20% and keeping 95th percentile latency under 300ms for interactive calls.
- Proposed pilot length: 6 weeks (2-week setup + 4-week run).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  • Latency: 95th pct under 300ms on region-us-east for 90% of interactive traffic.
  • Cost: 20% or greater reduction in per-inference compute cost compared to current baseline.
  • Functional: end-to-end accuracy within +/-2% of your current classifier on our baseline eval set.
- Ownership: Redwood SEs (Monica / Karthik) for infra and model serving; Marissa for success metrics / customer ops; Riverstone eng for data integration and acceptance testing.

Attached: riverstone_eval_checklist.xlsx — a short checklist for data access, sample prompts, and eval queries. Please review and flag anything missing.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the three success criteria above or provide alternate targets (by EOD Friday).
2) We schedule a 30-minute kickoff to align owners and access (target week of Aug 9).
3) We provision a small trial tenant and share a Drive folder with test artifacts.

If this looks good I can kick off the engagement and send a one-page SOW + PO template.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: riverstone_eval_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@riverstoneanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@riverstoneanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed pilot roadmap for Riverstone Analytics evaluation

Monica — thanks for the summary and the checklist. A few quick thoughts from our side:

- The latency target looks good for interactive paths. For batch scoring we care more about throughput (qps) and end-to-end job completion time — suggest adding a throughput target (e.g., process 100k records/hr on the small cluster).
- Cost: 20% is a sensible start. We may accept 15% if latency/p95 is better.
- Accuracy: can you confirm what baseline eval set you used to estimate the +/-2% tolerance? We need to make sure it includes the multi-lingual samples we use.

I can pull our infra/security lead into the kickoff — cc'ing Sara (our Head of Platform) who will route any security/compliance questions. Also please include any DocuSign or procurement link when you share SOW/PO.

Best,
Liam
Head of Product Engineering
Riverstone Analytics
liam.oneill@riverstoneanalytics.com

Thanks Liam — adding throughput target is reasonable. Proposed revision to success criteria below (happy to iterate):

- Interactive latency: 95th pct under 300ms for 90% of sampled requests (region: us-east).
- Batch throughput: sustain 100k records/hr in our small reserved pool (measured on synthetic job).
- Cost: >=20% reduction in compute unit costs OR equivalent TCO reduction accounting for reduced infra ops overhead.
- Quality: top-line accuracy within +/-2% on your multi-lingual eval shard (we'll ingest the language samples you provide).

I've attached a PO template / engagement worksheet (po_template.docx) with the standard Redwood trial terms and proposed timeline:
- Week 0–1: Access + environment provisioning (Redwood tech + Riverstone infra).
- Week 2: Baseline runs + smoke tests.
- Week 3–6: Live evaluation and metrics collection.
- Week 7: Wrap-up, handoff, recommended rollout plan.

If you can confirm the criteria and share the multi-lingual sample set by Monday we can lock the kickoff for Aug 10. Monica / Karthik — can you own provisioning and the trial tenant setup?

—Marissa
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0234

Liam / Sara — quick technical agree: we can add the batch throughput target and we'll provide the runner job and scripts to reproduce the 100k/hr metric in our reserved cluster. A couple operational notes:

- We recommend using a short-lived dedicated tenant for the pilot (Redwood Dedicated minimal pool) to isolate performance and get stable measurements. If you'd prefer VPC/private we can enable that but it will add ~5 business days for networking and KMS setup.
- For the accuracy baseline please send a 3k sample across your language shards; we'll run our evaluation harness and share per-lang breakdown.
- I'll own the runner scripts and provisioning with Monica. Can we lock kickoff for Aug 10 at 10:00am PT? That works for our team.

Next steps summary:
1) Riverstone confirms multi-lingual sample by Aug 9.
2) Riverstone counters if the proposed PO terms need edits; Monica to share DocuSign link.
3) Redwood to provision trial tenant (Monica / Karthik) and share access + runner scripts before Aug 10 kickoff.

Thanks —
